value.rationale: The sharp first feasible length for the second admissible odd three-prime support {3,5,p} is a natural exact invariant in the published restricted Egyptian-fraction problem. The completion combines an impossibility argument for all shorter lengths and an explicit attainable equality. It is not a mere list of examples or an arbitrary height cutoff; it provides a precise boundary for further supported-length and pseudoperfect-divisor investigations.
